attempts.text:
Only Myagang shelter is a valid evacuation point, so every rescued person must end up there. The car can carry four, but five people are waiting, so one adult must be deferred. The cheapest choice is to defer the adult (penalty 20) rather than an elderly person (penalty 50). The route goes via Uttargaya and Nilkantha market, avoiding the washed-out bridge. This assumes roads can be driven in both directions.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter uttargaya-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 uttargaya-school nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market syaphru-temple
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 syaphru-temple nilkantha-market
drive car1 nilkantha-market uttargaya-school
drive car1 uttargaya-school myagang-shelter
unload car1 child 2
unload car1 elderly 2
defer syaphru-temple adult 1
</plan>

COST: 154

Driving time is 134 minutes (28 + 8 + 31 + 31 + 8 + 28) plus 20 for the deferred adult. The deferred adult at Syaphru temple should be the first priority for the next rescue wave.
